user.title: Miniem
user.description: Paste the JSON key of a Firebase service account allowed to send Cloud Messaging (Firebase console → Project settings → Service accounts → Generate new private key). The launcher connects itself afterwards, with a long-lived access token.

error.missing_fields: The JSON is missing project_id, client_email, private_key or token_uri.
error.not_service_account: That is not a service account key.
error.token_refused: Google refused the key. Is it current, and does the account have the Firebase Cloud Messaging API Admin role?

show_card.name: Show card
show_card.description: Put a card on the Miniem launcher's Home Assistant panel. A card with the same id replaces the old one.

card.name: Card
card.description: The card: id, title, subtitle, body. See docs/home-assistant.md in the Miniem repository.

focus.name: Bring up the panel
focus.description: Open the panel on the phone now, instead of only showing a dot under the clock.

ttl.name: Time to live
ttl.description: Remove the card after this many seconds.

notification_title.name: Notification title
notification_title.description: For the notification shown when the panel cannot be brought up. Defaults to the card title.

clear_card.name: Clear card
clear_card.description: Take a card off the panel.

card_id.name: Card id
card_id.description: The id the card was shown with.
